notes: Stratified equal samples of actual randomized regional runs; frozen live enemy teams, IVs, seeds, trainers, rewards and organization assignments. Every continued run assumes earlier wins, so recording ends villain events after the first boss. Both sides use public-information policies; versions are specified by playerAI/opponentAI. Initial player tera ticket 1, opponent tickets frozen in each encounter; consumes actual tera protocol, buys 900-coin ticket when empty after useful gear/TMs and before consumables, preserving 400 reserve. Own-stat/type team selection, best-BST capture, six-member collection approximation, full recovery per floor, primary-type tera defaults. Current price and shop hash conventions, exact stock sizes, at most 2 vitamins and 4 rerolls/category. No future enemy knowledge. Simulated strategies, not human win rates; regional sampling intentionally differs from random population weighting.
